# Stage B protocol (declared before any Stage B result existed)

Amended once, before any trial result existed, because of a time limit. This is the protocol that is run.
Results come only from `run_stage_b.py` and are written to `results/phase3/<scenario>/`; nothing in a report may
come from anywhere else.

## Data
* `data/phase3/<scenario>/` (local-mean target), generated by `build_phase3_dataset.py` with its defaults
  (6 runs per (user count, ACIR) point, 600 slots of 0.5 s, base seed 1000 + per-scenario offset).
  The channel model is not changed to rescue a result.

## Training budget (every run)
At most 40 epochs, early-stopping patience 6 on validation loss, batch 64, no dropout, no weight decay,
gradient clip 1.0, 8 torch threads, one run at a time.

## Hyperparameter search (validation only, urban only)
* 5 configurations, 1 layer each: the repo default (hidden 96, lr 1e-3) plus hidden {64, 128} x lr {1e-3, 3e-4}.
  Run in that order, seed 42, one trial at a time, every trial logged (`search/trials.jsonl`, `search/trials.json`).
* Selection: lowest **validation loss** (normalised MSE); ties go to the smaller hidden size, fewer layers, larger
  learning rate. The search code receives only train/validation arrays.
* The urban-selected config is reused unchanged for rural: there is no rural search.
* The search was reduced because of a time limit. The originally declared grid (hidden {64, 96, 128} x lr {1e-3, 3e-4} x
  layers {1, 2}, 120 epochs, patience 12) was not run; this is stated in every summary JSON.
* After the first trial the driver prints its wall-clock time and an ETA for all remaining runs and stops (resumable with
  `--resume --accept-eta`) if that ETA exceeds 2 hours.

## Final training (test split evaluated once per config/seed)
* The chosen config is retrained with seeds **42, 43, 44** on urban, then on rural. After a config/seed has been evaluated on
  the test split the grid is closed: no re-runs with new settings. The driver refuses to write into existing results.

## Gates (fixed constants, never changed after results)
* Prototype gate: skill vs persistence >= 0.15. Final gate: skill >= 0.05 vs the best of persistence, 10-slot
  linear-power moving average and linear AR(10) (fitted on train).
* Both are evaluated on the **mean test MAE over the three seeds** (skill = 1 - mean MAE / baseline MAE), per scenario.
  Every seed, the mean and the sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) are reported. A failed gate is reported as failed.
* The Transformer is run only if the prototype gate fails on the mean (and not automatically).

## Commits
One commit per completed block: search; urban seeds; rural seeds. No commits while a run is in progress.

## Outputs per scenario
`summary.json` (aggregate, gates, baselines, every seed), `search/` (urban), `final/seed_<s>/` (summary, checkpoint, test
predictions), `training_curves.png`, `actual_vs_predicted.png`. Each JSON carries `run_info` (seed, library versions, torch
threads, git SHA, dirty flag and dirty files, command line) and the dataset's SHA-256 hashes.
